Name: Ramrod
Description: Ramrod's true name or full history remains a mystery besides the fact that he originally was a foreman for an off-shore oil rig who was very notorious for his strict and abusive like behavior towards his workers. This strict attitude one day found itself backfiring against Ramrod when his pushed his workers to where an oil drum fell on Ramrod, causing all bones within his body to break. As to what happened after the accident remains unknown when Ramrod awoke on a spaceship not only fully restored back to normal, but having his entire skeletal system replaced with steel.
